What is the equation of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
From the diagram we see that the parabola is upward-opening, has its vertex at $(0,0),$ and passes through the point $(-5,2).$

For any upward or downward-opening parabola whose vertex is $(0,0),$ the general standard equation is given by

$$
{x}^{2}=4py
$$

where $p$ is a constant.

We know that the given parabola passes through the point $(-5,2),$ so we can substitute $x=-5$ and $y=2$ into the standard equation and solve for $p:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2} & =4py \\ (-5)^{2} & =4p(2) \\ 25 & =8p \\ p & =\frac{25}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the equation of the parabola is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2} & =4py \\ {x}^{2} & =4(\frac{25}{8})y \\ {x}^{2} & =\frac{25}{2}y.\end{aligned}
$$
